clusters.whyHere: Crux's home base (Fathimapur). Thimmapur industrial cluster, the TGIIC Kothur industrial area and JCK Horizon warehouse park (1.3 mn sq ft), plus NH44 warehousing at Palmakole: steady JCB grading and crane steel-shed work
Airport zone: ORR Exit-15 Tondupally/Kishanguda warehouse belt, GMR Aerospace & Industrial Park, Kothwalguda quarries. Cranes for sheds, JCBs and excavators for site prep
NH44 between the ORR and Kothur: warehouse plots at Peddashapur and Gandiguda, Pedda Gollapally south of the airport. JCB grading, some crane work
Nandigama mandal HQ, a separate catchment from Kothur. Pharma plants (MSN, Credo; Natco and MSN IV at Mekaguda) and IDA Kothur: plant civil works, JCBs and cranes

Shadnagar, the largest town on the corridor: lorry/tipper owners' base, industrial units (Elikatta, Chattanpally), southern Regional Ring Road planned to cross NH44 nearby. Biggest JCB owner pool expected
Chilkamarri/Solipur on NH44 south of Shadnagar: MSN Unit V and packaging units, Raikal toll stretch. JCB and excavator owners along the highway
Balanagar mandal HQ in a feldspar/quartz/building-stone belt with approved stone crushers (Udithyal, Gouthampur) and the Burgula industrial land: excavators and rock-breaker JCBs

Rajapur, next to the Green Industrial Park (Polepally pharma SEZ: Aurobindo, Hetero, Mylan, Shilpa) with continuous plant expansion. Cranes, JCBs, excavators; southern Ring Road reported (provisional)
Jadcherla NH44/NH167 junction town: main base for owners working the SEZ, the PRLIS reservoirs and Divitipally
PRLIS Uddandapur reservoir (16 TMC), packages 17–18, target June 2027: excavators, dozers, tippers. Few villages mapped in OSM
Divitipally Electronics Manufacturing Cluster: Amara Raja gigafactory (262 acres) plus Lohum, Altmin and Scell plants under construction. Cranes and excavators
Bhoothpur mandal HQ on NH44 south, the nearest town to PRLIS Karivena reservoir works (packages 14–15; the Karivena point is about 7.1 km from the hub, just outside the circle)
Mahabubnagar district HQ: the district's biggest owner base, road and municipal works; the transport office is a lead source
